item.title: Google Maps Now Shows 'Lake America' in U.S. Following Trump Order
item.description: Google began updating its maps to rename Lake Ontario as 'Lake America' after President Trump signed an executive order mandating the change.

item.title: Video: Woman says she was thrown from Colorado mountain coaster
item.description: A woman claims she was thrown from her seat, dragged along the tracks, and suffered serious injuries.

item.title: Ontario premier warns trade war would be 'devastating' for both nations
item.description: Ford also called Trump's renaming of Lake Ontario "disappointing."
